screening.screening_rationale: Interviewer's standardized introduction and task instructions are clear, coherent, and goal-directed. 'T l I' represents an acronym being spelled out (TLI interview protocol). Speech demonstrates appropriate professional register with efficient information conveyance and no evidence of thought disorder across any TALD domain.

Interviewer provides clear transitional feedback and task progression. You go is colloquial shorthand (you are done/good) representing informal but contextually appropriate speech. Utterance demonstrates coherent task sequencing with efficient communication and no evidence of thought disorder across any TALD domain.

Interviewer provides standard task transition to final photo. And Jim minute begins now appears anomalous (expected: your minute), likely representing transcription artifact or isolated speech slip. Jim and your lack semantic relationship, excluding semantic paraphasia diagnosis. Context of professional interviewer protocol speech and absence of other FTD indicators across all domains supports benign interpretation rather than pathological thought disorder.
